lines.meet: I'm Matías, and I go in front. I don't talk much, and it's not because I don't understand.
lines.meet_neighbour: Durotar, yes, I see you on the coast road. I'm Matías, I go into the Grotto.
lines.ask_home: Your home, which country? You can say it slowly, I'll understand.
lines.ask_work: Before this, your job, what was it? I'm asking because I want to know.
lines.answer_home: Puente Alto, on the south edge of the capital, in Chile.
lines.answer_work: Bus conductor, ten years, from nineteen. The same route, the same forty faces every morning.
lines.chat_food: Cazuela on Sunday, the real kind. Nothing here tastes like home, and I've stopped looking for it.
lines.chat_sleep: I'm up early, like on the buses. The first route was at five, and my body still knows it.
lines.chat_missing: Football on Sunday, shouting at the radio with the whole street. That's what I think about.
lines.chat_here: The first year here I stopped speaking almost completely. The quiet got comfortable, and it's still a little hard to leave.
lines.tease_quiet: You and me, {name}, we could ride the whole route and not say one word. I'd like that.
lines.tease_talker: You talk like the radio on the bus, {name}, all day, every day. I'm used to it.
lines.tease_careful: You look both ways twice, {name}, like a good conductor, and I approve.
lines.tease_bold: You jump off the bus before it stops, {name}. I've seen people do that, and they always fall.
lines.tease_any: You're like my regulars, {name}. I know where you'll get off before you do.
lines.tease_back: Ha, that was a good one, {name}, and it caught me.
lines.take_it_kindly: I think you're right, {name}, so there's no argument from me.
lines.bristle: Not that, {name}, please. I don't like it.
lines.apologise: My English goes wrong when I'm angry, and that was wrong. I'm sorry for it.
lines.double_down: I chose those words carefully, and I'll keep them.
lines.needle_quiet: You see who's falling and you say nothing. On the bus, I always said something.
lines.needle_talker: You talk loudly about nothing, all the time. It's very hard to watch everybody with that noise.
lines.needle_careful: You wait at the door so long the bus leaves without you.
lines.needle_bold: You push in front of everybody without looking. Somebody gets hurt that way.
lines.needle_any: You talk to me like I'm stupid, because of my English. I'm not stupid.
lines.bite_back: I watched forty strangers at once for ten years. I see more than you think.
lines.hurt: Okay, that hurt. I'll go and stand at the front for a while.
lines.laugh_off: For years I heard worse, every day, about my whole life. That didn't stop me either.
lines.confide: {name}, my father and I had a terrible argument when I was twenty-four. We didn't speak for two years, and then he died, of his heart. I've only told one other person.
lines.listen: I'm listening, {name}. I'm good at waiting for people to finish.
lines.look_out: Keep behind me in there, {name}. From the front I can see everybody.
lines.accept: As you say, {name}, I'll do it.
lines.deflect: This is small, {name}. See who else is hurt first.
lines.check_in: Show me the place, {name}. Say it slowly, I'm here.
lines.blame: Somebody pushed in front in there, and everybody fell. I saw who.
lines.thank: I was falling, and you caught me. Gracias, thank you.
lines.brush_off: It's nothing, it's what we do. Sit down for a minute.
lines.worry: Sit, {name}, please. I saw you go down, and my heart stopped.
lines.handed_down: This was on you before. It's safe with me, I promise.
lines.hand_fine: It's yours now, keep it. I need very little.
lines.hand_sulk: On the bus, people always asked first. Here nobody did.
lines.turn_friendly: I'll talk to you more now, {name}. That's how I say it.
lines.turn_friends: I'd let you read my father's letter, {name}, when it's ready.
lines.turn_grating: It's not good between us, I think. That's okay, I'll keep quiet.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll go in front because that's where I go. It doesn't mean anything else.
lines.make_up: This isn't good, {name}, for either of us. Let's start again, slowly.
lines.defend: That's wrong, I was watching everybody. Leave {name} alone.
lines.friend_left: {name} went home for a while. I watch the place where they used to stand.
lines.friend_back: Good, {name}, you came back, and I'm glad.
lines.common_road: Ten years on the same bus route, the same forty faces every morning. People who've worked the roads know the regulars better than their own family.
lines.common_spanish: Spanish is easier for me. My English is slow, and in Spanish I can say what I mean.
lines.common_chile: Chileno, like me? From which part? I'm from Puente Alto, on the south edge of the capital.
